column5: ICO electronic mail marketing (now read in full): no marketing emails or texts to individuals without specific consent, except the soft opt-in for existing customers who bought or negotiated to buy something similar and were offered an opt-out at collection and in every message; companies, LLPs, Scottish partnerships and government bodies may be emailed, keeping a 'do not email' list; sole traders and some partnerships count as individuals. Matches the module 6 table.

ICO electronic mail marketing: the rule covers emails, texts, picture and video messages, voicemails and direct messages on social media; you must not disguise your identity and must give a valid address for opting out; there is no email or text version of the TPS.

ICO electronic mail marketing: asking customers to forward your marketing to friends, or to give you friends' contact details, makes you the instigator and still subject to PECR; the ICO advises against both. Relevant to the referral prospecting technique in module 2.
